svg.title: OpenDART SDK · package design
svg.desc: The calling application uses OpenDART and six generated resources. Pydantic settings configure the shared httpx2 transport, which exchanges JSON or ZIP responses with the FSS English API and returns validated models, bytes, or SDK errors. Checked-in OpenAPI files generate the committed resources and models offline.
svg.text: RUNTIME · requests, configuration and response handling
GENERATION · development inputs → shipped Python code
Included in the installed SDK wheel
OpenAPI files and the generator are development inputs; installed clients use the committed code.
pytest + httpx2.MockTransport + synthetic responses · Ruff · Pyrefly · generated-file freshness checks
Blue: request / response flow · Gray: settings · Dashed teal: offline code generation
